answer: The door is Certified waller coping log with wallers endorsement. The key is four-year apprenticeship, 6,000 supervised hours, practical exam, guild dues, cut once, for one hand, and it cannot be copied. Every alias pays its own way: 119 POA locked, 16 minutes spent, and 604 aliases means 71876 POA gone. The tundra tells you who issued it, the echo tells you what it cost, and the zenith tells you when it was earned. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
